core_contribution.summary: Turn the existing Qwen section engine from unused machinery into the bounded production authoring seam.

acceptance_checks_passed: The canonical verified candidate seam invokes qwen3-next for eligible bounded prose clusters and accepted authored bytes are visible in the rendered candidate with exact fact accountability
Deterministic validation rejects unknown, do-not-claim, missing, or altered fact use before render
A retryable transport failure and one repairable semantic failure recover only the affected cluster within the declared call budget
An identical transaction performs zero provider calls and changing one packet re-authors only that packet while reusing every unchanged accepted cluster
Portfolio progress derives packets-ready and sections-authored from checksum-valid persisted evidence
The live and controlled receipts quantify provider calls, reused clusters, invalidated clusters, elapsed time, and the avoided whole-document recomputation
